literal_meaning: শিমুল গাছের ফুল (red cotton tree flower)
figurative_meaning_en: All beauty without substance; a beautiful person lacking inner qualities
similar_in_english: All that glitters is not gold
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে শিমুলফুলের মতো, বাইরে থেকে সুন্দর কিন্তু গুণে শূন্য।
এই ছেলেটি শিমুলফুল, রূপ আছে কিন্তু বুদ্ধি নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: She is like a simul flower, beautiful on the outside but empty inside.
This guy is a simul flower—looks good but has no real merits.
history: The idiom draws from the Simul tree (Bombax ceiba), native to Bengal, symbolizing fleeting beauty in rural folklore.
note: Common in Bengali poetry and proverbs to highlight superficial allure.
